thread:
Ava: Quick heads-up  noticed a batch of PRs using mixed param styles: `modelId`, `model_id`, and `model-id`. Snippet tests are flaky because of this. Can we pick one and enforce it?
Dev: We agreed on param-case (kebab) for params in code/examples. So `model-id` should be canonical.
Riley: I'll add a one-liner to the PR template: 'Use param-case for params in code and config (e.g., `model-id`).' Also will add a link to /docs/glossary#param-case.
Sam: I'll sweep the open PRs I own and update snippets. Example change: `client.generate(modelId: 'redwood-1')` -> `client.generate({'model-id': 'redwood-1'})`.
DocsBot: note: docs-snippet-test flagged 5 files containing `modelId` or `model_id`. Those need fixes before merging.
Ava: Can we also add a lightweight CI grep to catch camel/snake variants in /docs/snippets? Riley: yes, I can open a tiny CI PR with grep: `grep -R "\bmodelId\b|\bmodel_id\b" docs/snippets/` and fail if matches.
Dev: And add a short note in /docs/style.md under 'parameter naming': 'Use param-case for inline code/config keys; prose may use "model ID" for readability.'
Sam: After I update the snippets I'll post links to the PRs here for quick review.
Ava: Thanks team. Plan: Riley -> PR template + CI grep, Sam -> snippet fixes, Dev -> style.md blurb. Merge goal today if CI green. :thumbsup:
